priorityList: Cast Shadow Dance when you have 2 or fewer combo points and Secret Technique is ready or Shadow Blades is active.
Cast Shadow Blades during Shadow Dance.
Cast Secret Technique during Shadow Dance with 6 or more combo points.
Cast Eviscerate with 6 or more combo points when Darkest Night is active.
Cast Black Powder with 6 or more combo points.
Cast Shuriken Storm to build combo points.
Always start the fight off with a Shadowstrike.
Do not cast Shadow Dance when Shadow Blades has less than 10 seconds left of its cooldown.
On exactly 2 targets it is slightly better to build combo points with Shadowstrike over Shuriken Storm whenever it is available.
